name: calculate_settlement
description: Calculate a recommended settlement amount for a claim from the damage assessment, deductible, depreciation, and policy limit. Returns a breakdown, comparable settlements, and approve/review recommendation.

coverage_limit.description: Maximum coverage limit from the policy in USD

name: approve_settlement
description: Approve a settlement for payment processing. Returns payment reference, estimated payment date, and compliance check results. Settlements over $25,000 require supervisor approval.

approver_notes.description: Notes from the approver documenting the decision rationale

name: get_settlement_analytics
description: Get settlement analytics and performance metrics for the current month: KPIs, breakdown by claim type, and month-over-month trends.

name: estimate_reserve
description: Estimate the loss reserve for an open claim using severity-based actuarial modeling (Chain-Ladder with Bornhuetter-Ferguson). Returns reserve estimate with P10/P50/P90 confidence interval and component breakdown.

claim_type.description: Type of claim (e.g., auto, home, health, property, liability)

severity.description: Claim severity (One of: low, medium, high, catastrophic)
